title: C++: Builder Pattern
description: Implement the Builder pattern for constructing complex Pizza objects.

steps.title: Pizza Builder
steps.description: Create a `Pizza` class with size, cheese, pepperoni, mushrooms, olives fields. Create a `PizzaBuilder` class with fluent methods: setSize(), addCheese(), addPepperoni(), addMushrooms(), addOlives(), build(). Build a large pizza with cheese and pepperoni.
